title: Prepare to clean for days....
text: Prepare to clean for days..... I wanted a collection of airtight containers...  The sizes are just as represented... the down side?  The cleaning process.  Good heavens. I included a pic of the 7 steps necessary...  I'm afraid I am not an "airtight" container consumer.  I am still considering whether or not I will keep them...  For now I am keeping things inside their bags and then in to the containers to reduce the number of times I have to go through the cleaning process.  I always update my reviews if new information would be helpful.  Further, I do NOT receive compensation of ANY kind for my reviews.
